title: Students enrolled in all subjects
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on students, subjects, enrollments.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.subject_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subjects) ORDER BY s.name
